subject: french
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in French on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (French↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.q: What does 'l'hébergement' mean?
questions.explain: 'L'hébergement' means 'accommodation'. 'Food' is 'la nourriture'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I would like to book a double room'?
options: Je voudrais réserver une chambre double
Je voudrais annuler une chambre simple
Je voudrais payer une chambre double
Je voudrais réserver une chaise double
questions.explain: 'Réserver' = 'to book' and 'une chambre double' = 'a double room'; 'annuler' (cancel) and 'simple' (single) are distractors.

questions.q: What does 'faire les valises' mean?
questions.explain: 'Faire les valises' is the set phrase 'to pack (the suitcases)'.

questions.q: What does 'Le train est en retard' mean?
questions.explain: 'En retard' means 'late/delayed', so 'Le train est en retard' = 'The train is late'.

questions.q: What does 'télécharger' mean?
questions.explain: 'Télécharger' means 'to download' (and can mean upload with 'téléverser'/'mettre en ligne').

questions.q: What does 'un ordinateur' mean?
questions.explain: 'Un ordinateur' means 'a computer'. A printer is 'une imprimante'.

questions.q: What does 'le mot de passe' mean?
questions.explain: 'Le mot de passe' literally 'the word of passing' means 'the password'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I spend too much time online'?
options: Je passe trop de temps en ligne
Je passe peu de temps en ligne
Je passe trop de temps en retard
questions.explain: 'Passer du temps' = 'to spend time' and 'trop de' = 'too much', so this means 'I spend too much time online'.

questions.q: What does 'l'environnement' refer to here?
questions.explain: 'L'environnement' means 'the environment' (nature/planet), as in 'protéger l'environnement'.

questions.q: What does 'le réchauffement climatique' mean?
questions.explain: 'Le réchauffement climatique' means 'global warming / climate warming'.

questions.q: What does 'Je vis en banlieue' mean?
options: I live in the city centre
questions.explain: 'La banlieue' means 'the suburbs/outskirts', so 'Je vis en banlieue' = 'I live in the suburbs'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'There is a lot of pollution'?
options: Il y a beaucoup de pollution
Il y a peu de pollution
Il n'y a pas de pollution
Il y avait beaucoup de soleil
questions.explain: 'Il y a beaucoup de' = 'there is a lot of', so 'Il y a beaucoup de pollution' = 'There is a lot of pollution'.

questions.q: What does 'le covoiturage' mean?
questions.explain: 'Le covoiturage' means 'car-sharing/carpooling'. A traffic jam is 'un embouteillage'.

questions.q: What does 'On devrait recycler davantage' mean?
questions.explain: 'On devrait' is the conditional of 'devoir' = 'we should'; 'davantage' = 'more'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'Next year I will travel to Canada' (future)?
options: L'année prochaine je voyagerai au Canada
L'année dernière j'ai voyagé au Canada
questions.explain: 'Je voyagerai' is the future tense 'I will travel'; with 'l'année prochaine' (next year) the future is correct.

questions.q: What does 'Il faut protéger la planète' mean?
options: We want to protect the planet
questions.explain: 'Il faut' + infinitive means 'one/we must', so 'Il faut protéger la planète' = 'We must protect the planet'.

questions.q: What does 'à l'étranger' mean?
questions.explain: 'À l'étranger' means 'abroad'. ('Un étranger' can mean 'a foreigner/stranger', but 'à l'étranger' = abroad.)

questions.q: What does 'une émission' mean (TV)?
questions.explain: False friend: 'une émission' is a TV/radio programme, not an 'emission'.

questions.q: What does 'les déchets' mean?
questions.explain: 'Les déchets' means 'waste/rubbish'. 'Trier les déchets' = 'to sort the waste'.

questions.q: What does 'Actuellement, je vis en ville' mean?
options: I used to live in town
questions.explain: False friend: 'actuellement' means 'currently/at the moment', not 'actually' (which is 'en fait').
